schedule: 120s initial uninterrupted rest, then 60 shuffled blocks (20 per class), each 1.5-3.0s; movement strength uniform 0.3-1.0; schedule RNG 900000+session
selection: minimum validation cross entropy; train-only standardization; no test tuning
gate: argmax class, two consecutive matching movement predictions, immediate rest, 250ms command expiry; same for all models; no probability threshold tuning
baselines: MLP seed101 trained with block-shuffled labels
metrics: raw confusion/recall plus gated events and occupancy; false event starts on rest entry or command direction change; movement episode detected only by correct direction; onset includes window/gate delay; misses separate; no transition removal
scope: nominal noisy recordings, new sessions of one fixed simulated anatomy; no deliberate disturbance generalization, human EEG, robot integration, or RL in this milestone
